contentHtml:
The UAE has long positioned itself as a global hub for entrepreneurs. One of the most lucrative initiatives introduced by the UAE government is the Golden Visa program. It continuously opens doors for international talents and investors, offering unmatched advantages such as long-term residency, business freedom, and lifestyle privileges. The golden visa for business owners is especially valuable, granting entrepreneurs the stability and incentives needed to thrive in the UAE’s dynamic economy.

Since there are many advantages as a Golden Visa holder, The UAE Gate is your trusted partner in providing essential information. This guide will walk you through everything you need to know about obtaining a Golden Visa UAE for business owners — including its benefits, eligibility criteria, investment options, costs, and the complete application process.

What is the UAE Golden Visa?

The Dubai Golden Visa for business owners is a long-term residency permit. Granted to eligible foreigners to contribute to the UAE’s economy. This UAE visa is self-sponsored, unlike regular visas, and is valid for up to 10 years. Designed to attract high-value individuals or business owners. Ones who are ready to invest, innovate, or inspire.

Why the Golden Visa is Ideal for Business Owners

The golden visa has its own charm due to the several benefits it offers. The visa has a long-term residency option. You can reside up to 5 to 10 years. The visa holder enjoys 100% business ownership and doesn’t need a local sponsor or employer.

The Golden Visa enables access to public services like healthcare and education. You can sponsor your family with this visa, including your spouse and children. This visa allows you to travel free to 130+ countries.

Additionally, experience tax-free personal income and business earnings by having a golden visa in hand.

Golden Visa Eligibility Criteria For Business Owners in 2025

Including business owners, the golden visa is tailor-made for a wide range of individuals, such as:

  • Investors in real estate or public investments
  • Entrepreneurs and startup founders
  • Scientists and professionals
  • Highly-skilled workers and executives
  • Students and academic achievers
  • Artists, creatives, and inventors
  • Humanitarian workers and frontline heroes

Golden Visa for Business Owners: Key Insights

Here’s what you need if you’re a business owner looking to expand or relocate to the UAE:

  • Investment proof of AED 2 million or more
  • Valid commercial license and financial reports
  • Business must be registered and operational in the UAE
  • Clean criminal record
  • Valid passport (6 months minimum)

Acceptable Investment Formats:

  • Real estate (residential or commercial)
  • Business capital in an existing or new venture
  • Contribution to public sector projects or funds

Benefits of Holding a Golden Visa in the UAE

Having a UAE Golden Visa has many advantages. You’ll experience self-sponsorship with no dependency on an employer. The visa comes with extended stay. You can live abroad for longer without losing your visa.

The visa grants you family coverage, including dependents of any age. You have employment freedom to work or launch new ventures freely. Avail top-notch healthcare and education by accessing top public and private services. You can have real estate ownership with this visa. Enjoy long-term returns and value growth.

How to Apply for the Golden Visa UAE in 2025

As a business owner, a simplified step-by-step process must be followed:

Step 1: Entry Visa
To initiate the process, apply for a 6-month multiple-entry visa.

Step 2: Complete the Investment
Finalize your business setup or property investment.

Step 3: Submit Application
Apply via the ICP Smart Services portal or a certified service provider.

Step 4: Document Submission
Provide all required documents. Missing documents? You have 30 days to upload.

Step 5: Approval & Issuance
Once approved, you receive a confirmation via SMS and email.

Documents You Need to Apply

Are you a business owner and don’t know what documents you need to apply for a Golden Visa? Then, the following document checklist is for you. These documents are required to apply for a Golden Visa UAE:

  • Valid passport (minimum 6-month validity)
  • Proof of investment (real estate or business documents)
  • Salary certificate (if applicable)
  • Emirates ID (if already a resident)
  • Health insurance policy
  • Recent photographs
  • Academic certificates (for skilled professionals)

Cost of Golden Visa for Business Owners

The Golden Visa for business owners in UAE has different cost structures. It primarily depends on the investment method. The application fee is AED 650. However, there are other costs also associated with the specific investment.

FAQs

Can I apply for a Golden Visa for my business if my company is new?

It is possible to apply for a business Golden Visa if your company is new. The specific requirements vary by country.

How long does the UAE Golden Visa for Business application take?

The application process for a UAE Golden Visa for business purposes typically takes 2-4 weeks for approval after submission.

Is the golden visa valid across all emirates?

The Golden Visa is valid across all emirates. The visa grants long-term residency, enabling individuals to reside, work, and study in the UAE. The visa holder doesn’t even need a national sponsor.

What if I close my business after getting a UAE golden visa?

Business closure in the UAE after obtaining a Golden Visa does not cancel the visa. The visa is linked to the individual’s eligibility criteria. It is not bound with the business itself.
